summary: How many starts with two closed fists that spring open upward, fingers spreading, with a questioning face.
handshape: S fists opening to spread hands
steps: Hold two fists in front of you, palms up.
Spring them open upward so the fingers spread.
Eyebrows down. Put it at the end: YOU HAVE SISTER HOW-MANY.
mistakes: Opening slowly. The spring is quick, like something popping up.
